question: how do i join a club here, do i just show up or do i have to sign up somewhere
answer:

They direct you to check each club’s instructions: for example, Animation Production Club says “Join us on Archway” [16], while Ramapo College Disc Club says to email rchammerultimate@ramapo.edu [21]. Explore clubs on Archway: https://archway.ramapo.edu/ [23], or browse https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/ [20]. question: does ramapo have greek life and how does rushing work for freshmen
answer:
Yes. Ramapo’s Greek community has 21 active fraternities and sororities [31]. Greek Life clubs include Lambda Theta Phi Latin Fraternity, Incorporated (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/Lambdas/), Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Inc. (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/que/), Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/Zeta%20P/), Tau Kappa Epsilon (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/TKE/), Phi Alpha Delta (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/PAD/), College Panhellenic Council (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/CPH/), Theta Phi Alpha (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/TPA/), Professional Fraternity Council (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/PFC/), Sigma Delta Tau (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/SDT/), Alpha Kappa Psi Professional Business Fraternity (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/AKPsi/), Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Inc. (Greek Life - Greek Letter Fraternities and Sororities; https://archway.ramapo.edu/sgrho/), Alpha Omicron Pi (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/AOII/), Delta Phi Epsilon (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/DPhiE/), Sigma Sigma Sigma (Greek Life; no page listed), Delta Chi (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/DCHI/), National Pan-Hellenic Conference (Greek Life - Greek Letter Fraternities and Sororities; https://archway.ramapo.edu/NPHC/), Alpha Sigma Phi (Greek Life - Greek Letter Fraternities and Sororities; https://archway.ramapo.edu/ASP/), Alpha Sigma Alpha (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/A%E2%95%AC%C3%BAA/), Alpha Phi Delta (Greek Life; https://www.apd.org/), Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc. (Greek Life; https://archway.ramapo.edu/AKA/), and Alpha Phi Omega (Greek Life - Greek Letter Fraternities and Sororities, Professional; https://archway.ramapo.edu/APO/) [1–21].

For freshmen: recruitment eligibility requires 12–23 Ramapo credits and a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or better, or 24 or more Ramapo credits and a cumulative GPA of 2.25 or better; good academic standing, no disciplinary probation, full-time enrollment, an in-person Hazing Prevention Workshop, signing the New Member Process Acknowledgment, and completing required online courses assigned by the Coordinator [26]. The separate eligibility page lists the credit/GPA thresholds and standing requirements but not full-time status or workshop/forms/courses [23]; the pages differ in their listed requirements. Transfer students may join in their first semester if in good standing [23, 26].

Complete the Greek Life Interest Form (https://cglink.me/2fF/s33074) for information about NPHC, PFC, IFC, CPH, and UCGC [27]. “Meet the Greeks” is typically held in the second week of fall semester and lets students meet Greek leaders and learn about organizations [28]. Formal recruitment for NPC member sororities is in spring and follows NPC guidelines; informal recruitment for NPC member sororities occurs in fall [29, 30].

The Office of Fraternity and Sorority Life can help: ofsl@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7123, SC-202B [22, 24].

Sources: [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/greek/academics/) [26](https://www.ramapo.edu/greek/recruitment/) [27](https://www.ramapo.edu/greek/recruitment/) [28](https://www.ramapo.edu/greek/programs/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-affairs/welcome-back-to-student-involvement-events-connections-more/)
